rule: A cell is PASS only with recorded evidence; parser-level or server-side tests never promote a native client above UNVERIFIED.

clients.hysteria2: PASS (singbox format; pinned format is REALITY-only by design)
clients.ipv6_inbound: PASS locally over the server's IPv6 literal
clients.tls_sni: PASS verified certificate, SNI = public host
clients.shorts: FAIL on this IP (source refused), see I-38

evidence.evidence_class: server-verified (loopback client on the staging node; NOT a native app)

required_tests: import profile from the served URL (format named below)
subscription refresh picks up a changed profile
VLESS+REALITY connects (record transport)
Hysteria2 connects where the client supports it (record transport)
client DNS resolves through the tunnel; no DNS leak (device observation)
IPv4 and IPv6 behaviour recorded (IPv6 leak check)
10 consecutive true Shorts + the known-failing Short + a normal video with seeking
Wi-Fi<->cellular switch and unexpected-disconnect recovery
error reporting is understandable (record any raw client error text)
